story1.text: "At the end of every civilization, the Archive arrives."
Wake up, Executioner. We have visitors.

story1.name: You
story1.text: (Ugh… My head… I'm still feeling the after effects from the latest mission.)

story1.name: You
story1.text: Ah. Hello, Senior Archivist Miller. What flavor of visitors do we have on our hands?

story1.name: Sr. Archivist Miller
story1.text: As you know, there are only two types of people who seek out the Archive. Those seeking knowledge, and those seeking revenge.

story1.name: You
story1.text: Well, Senior Archivist, I'm gonna need your assistance with this one. My motor skills and mind are in shambles after that last mission.

story1.name: Sr. Archivist Miller
story1.text: Fine, but follow exactly what I say.

game_tutorial.name: Sr. Archivist Miller
game_tutorial.text: Attention. It seems we are facing off against a Gooney.

game_tutorial.name: You
game_tutorial.text: Gooney? Man, they really need to come up with better names.

game_tutorial.name: Sr. Archivist Miller
game_tutorial.text: You can see your available cards at the bottom. Most cards cost energy. It's the number in the yellow circle. Your energy is located above your head. You gain one energy every turn.

game_tutorial.name: Sr. Archivist Miller
game_tutorial.text: Why did you ask me to help then?

game_tutorial.name: You
game_tutorial.text: You try getting hit over the head five times then.

game_tutorial.name: Sr. Archivist Miller
game_tutorial.text: Hmm… alright. Your deck is at the bottom right. You draw a new card from your deck at the start of your turn.

game_tutorial.name: You
game_tutorial.text: What's that icon in the top corner?

game_tutorial.name: Sr. Archivist Miller
game_tutorial.text: Your cards have different damage types. Some enemies have weaknesses to certain damage types, choose wisely when fighting.

game_tutorial.name: You
game_tutorial.text: So I just gotta hit them hard, right?

game_tutorial.name: Sr. Archivist Miller
game_tutorial.text: You executioners and your lower level of thinking…

game_tutorial.name: Sr. Archivist Miller
game_tutorial.text: Make sure to keep an eye out on the yellow bar under your HP. That's your stagger bar.

game_tutorial.name: Sr. Archivist Miller
game_tutorial.text: If it drops to zero, you'll get 'staggered' for the rest of this turn, the next, and take extra damage.

game_tutorial.name: Sr. Archivist Miller
game_tutorial.text: Of course, this applies to your foes too, so plan your actions accordingly… (Though that might be too tall of a task for you).

game_tutorial.name: Sr. Archivist Miller
game_tutorial.text: Nothing. Make sure to keep speed in mind, however you wouldn't be needing it in this fight.
